profiles.name: Mimi Benzell
profiles.excerpt: Mimi Benzell was an American soprano who moved from the Metropolitan Opera into concert, radio, television and nightclub work.
profiles.bio_html:
Mimi Benzell was born in Bridgeport, Connecticut in 1918 and trained as a classical soprano. She joined the Metropolitan Opera in the 1940s and sang leading lyric and coloratura roles before broadening her career beyond the opera house.

Radio and television made Benzell a familiar concert and variety singer. She appeared with major network orchestras, on programs including The Voice of Firestone, and as a guest soprano on The Railroad Hour, while also building a successful nightclub and concert career.

Golden Radio Hour currently preserves 10 The Railroad Hour broadcasts featuring Benzell. Those performances belong primarily with singers and vocalists because they document the same professional singing career that carried her from the Metropolitan Opera to national broadcasting.

profiles.name: Rudy Vallée
profiles.excerpt: Rudy Vallée was one of radio’s first great national stars, combining crooning, saxophone, bandleading, hosting and acting in a career that helped define broadcast variety.
profiles.bio_html:
Rudy Vallée was born Hubert Prior Vallée in Vermont in 1901 and emerged from the 1920s dance-band world as one of America’s first mass-media singing stars. His intimate crooning style, amplified by radio, made him a national celebrity before the modern pop-star model was fully established.

Vallée was also a saxophonist, bandleader and pioneering radio host. The Fleischmann’s Yeast Hour, which began in 1929, helped establish the radio variety format by combining music, comedy and guest performers under Vallée’s direction as master of ceremonies. Film and stage acting later became another substantial branch of his career.

Golden Radio Hour currently preserves appearances by Vallée on Duffy’s Tavern, The Big Show, Lux Radio Theatre, Sealtest Variety Theater, The Abbott and Costello Show and The Fred Allen Show. His public profile is led by singing while retaining his work as musician, host and actor.
